policy.copy: copy only selected files into the project; do not import a whole library
policy.record: record source path, commit, license, and what was adapted in decisions.md
policy.fullTemplate: Only use a full template/skill when the task matches its declared mode; never load the whole library.

capabilities.description: 51 film styles; STYLE.md + demo films + DIRECTOR.md/TECHNIQUE.md; code-first short-film skill.
capabilities.retrieval: Only when a named style or strong style uncertainty exists: pick 1 STYLE.md, read DIRECTOR.md as method reference, adapt to the current content.
constraints: Styles are tuned for Claude Opus 5.5; other models may not reproduce them.
Do not copy a demo film/still into a deliverable without CC BY attribution.
Do not load all 51 styles; retrieve one style at a time.
capabilitySurface: DIRECTOR.md: story, sound, rhythm, camera, performance, self-check
TECHNIQUE.md: frame rendering, voice, music, mixing
capabilities.defaultUse: For a named style film, use the full skill; for lookdev only, one STYLE.md; never load all styles.
capabilities.modelFit: Tuned for Claude Opus 5.5; other models may not reproduce reliably.

capabilities.description: 124 shot recipe cards / 150 shots, Remotion demos, product-video template, aesthetic rules, final review, sound design and beat sync references.
capabilities.retrieval: When a shot needs an existing motion grammar: pick 1-3 cards by function, read the card and its exact demo source, then adapt to the current visual system.
constraints: Focus is web/desktop product promos; not a default narrative-film template.
Do not load all 124 cards; retrieve by function/category.
Only borrow motion structure/parameters, not the whole skin/theme.
Keep Apache-2.0 notices and per-asset audio licenses.
capabilitySurface: 124 shot recipe cards / 150 shots in 10 categories
page capture scripts + 2.5D PageCam + reusable components
149 SFX / 5 BGM / beat sync / sound design
capabilities.fullTemplate: template/ -> 36.2s validated product promo; use only for product-promo; re-skin assets.
capabilities.defaultUse: For a matching product/UI promo, use SKILL.md + pipeline/template; for other films, retrieve 1-3 cards only.
capabilities.modelFit: Built for Claude Code/Codex; product-promo focus.

capabilities.description: 201+ Remotion motion scenes in 16 categories, with shared colors/easing/fonts/lerp utilities.
capabilities.retrieval: When a specific primitive is needed (text/data/transition/particle/UI), copy 1-2 components into the project and adapt tokens/dependencies.
constraints: Default visual styling must be re-skinned to the project tokens.
capabilities.defaultUse: Retrieve 1-2 components by category; no full film template.

routing.when: named style, narrative short, art film, evidence film
routing.load: lemo DIRECTOR.md + TECHNIQUE.md + 1 STYLE.md; optional 1-3 shotcraft cards and 1-2 scenes primitives
routing.doNot: do not load all 51 styles; do not use product-promo template as a narrative template

routing.when: product/UI/launch promo, page capture, beat-synced product film
routing.load: video-shotcraft SKILL.md + pipeline/template when matching + 1-3 cards + selected components/audio; optional 1 lemo style reference
routing.doNot: do not use the full 36.2s template for non-product films; re-skin all product-specific assets

routing.load: selected remotion-scenes components + 1-3 shotcraft cards; no full film template
routing.doNot: do not register all 201 scenes; do not force a narrative structure

routing.load: one style or one card or one component
routing.doNot: do not load a full pipeline for a smoke test
